title: React 19 Fundamentals
description: Build modern declarative user interfaces with React. Master components, props, useState, immutable updates, useEffect, lists & keys, and custom hooks.
outcomes: Think in React by breaking UIs into composable, pure function components
Pass typed data down via props and events up via callback props
Manage interactive UI state cleanly with useState and immutable updates
Render dynamic lists with stable key props and conditional UI
Synchronize side effects cleanly with useEffect and reusable custom hooks
